title: Grateful Dead Live at Market Square Arena on 1976-10-01
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:112800), Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD,Transfer Info:CD -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC, All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller; Audience (shnid:118467), SRC: Unknown AUD (likely FOB),Lineage: Nakamichi DR-1 >Tascam HD-P2 > 24 bit/96 khz WAV > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Stellar audience recording of a 1976 show with a smoking Help / Slipknot / Franklin's Tower sequence in the second set.
ai_review.review: The tape, captured from an audience Nagra recorder, is praised for its clear and lively sound despite years of handling. The performance shines especially in the second set, highlighted by a killer Help on the Way → Slipknot! → Franklin’s Tower run that many reviewers call "smoking" and deeply personal.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive about both the music (especially the second‑set sequence) and the audio quality, yielding a strong combined score; limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded on a Nagra RTR 7.5 IPS tape recorder; many generations of copying have introduced some wear, but overall the sound is clear and "stellar" according to reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is described as smoking and the overall show is considered an excellent 1976 performance.
